statements.impact_statement: file-type 16.5.4 (via etcher-sdk; endless loop in the ASF parser on malformed input). etcher-sdk runs it (fromStream in source-destination.js) only on the image being flashed, and FlockFlasher flashes nothing but images of the signed FlockOS catalog, after checking the download's size and SHA-256 against it (src/main/security/catalog.ts, integrity.ts). The fix (21.3.1) is ESM-only, which etcher-sdk's require() cannot load; drop this when etcher-sdk moves on.

glob 10.5.0 (AbortSignal cancellation bypass) is a declared dependency of etcher-sdk, but etcher-sdk's build never loads it (no require of glob under node_modules/etcher-sdk/build), and FlockFlasher does not use glob either. Drop this when etcher-sdk updates or removes it.

minimatch (denial of service through a crafted glob pattern). 9.0.9 is a declared dependency of etcher-sdk (and of its glob) that etcher-sdk's build never loads; 10.2.6 belongs to the build tooling only and is not shipped. Neither ever sees a pattern an attacker supplies: the only patterns are the repository's own build configuration. Drop this when etcher-sdk updates or removes it.
